title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时

questions.stem: I ____ my key. I can't get into the house now.

options.distractor: 后半句说“现在进不去”，强调对现在的影响
丢钥匙是已经发生的事
lose 不用进行时表示“弄丢”

questions.explanation: “现在进不去”说明丢钥匙影响了现在，用 have lost。

options.distractor: last week 是具体过去时间点，不能用完成时
过去分词不能单独作谓语

questions.explanation: last week 是具体过去时间点，用一般过去时 saw。

questions.stem: — ____ you ____ your homework? — Yes, I have.

options.distractor: 答语是 Yes, I have，问句要一致
问的是到目前为止有没有完成

questions.explanation: 答语 Yes, I have 说明问句是 Have you finished…

questions.stem: She ____ in this factory since she left school.

options.distractor: since 从句说明状态从过去持续到现在
worked 表示过去工作过、现在不在这了
since 引导的时间段不与进行时连用

questions.explanation: since 引导的起点 + 持续到现在，用 has worked。

options.text: I have seen the film twice.
I have bought the book yesterday.
We have lived here for years.

questions.explanation: yesterday 是具体过去时间点，应改为 I bought the book yesterday。

questions.stem: — When ____ you ____ (buy) this bike? — Last month.

options.distractor: 答语是具体过去时间点，不能用完成时

questions.explanation: 问“什么时候买的”指向具体过去时间，用 did…buy。
